cast.name: KNC Jar
cast.description: The talking DERMDOC 2% Kojic Acid Night Cream jar (cobalt-blue base, white lid, cartoon face, little arms). Team captain of the ingredients: sassy, bossy, playful cartoon voice, bright mid-high female pitch (~255 Hz).

cast.name: Kojic Acid
cast.description: Golden spiky Kojic Acid ingredient hero that zaps dark spots with golden light. Brave, determined, punchy action-hero cartoon voice, the lowest and strongest of the three ingredients (~235 Hz).

cast.name: Niacinamide
cast.description: Silver-white Niacinamide ingredient hero with a little brush that sweeps away the grey dullness haze. Cool, breezy, cheerful cartoon voice, a bit brighter than Kojic Acid.

cast.name: Alpha Arbutin
cast.description: Small pink droplet Alpha Arbutin ingredient hero who evens out the two-tone villain. Cute, sweet, confident, squeakiest voice of the team (~250 Hz).

cast.name: Narrator
cast.description: Off-screen brand voiceover over the application shot, before/after and end frame. Warm, confident, premium female narrator, natural human voice (~225 Hz).

lines.speaker: kojic_jar
lines.or: କଣ ଡାର୍କ ସ୍ପଟ, ପୁଣି ମିଟିଂ ଚାଲିଛି?

lines.speaker: kojic_jar
lines.bn: টিম কে এন সি, মিটিং ক্যানসেল!
lines.ta: டீம் கே என் சி, மீட்டிங் கேன்சல்!
lines.te: టీమ్ కె ఎన్ సి, మీటింగ్ క్యాన్సిల్!
lines.ml: ടീം കെ എൻ സി, മീറ്റിംഗ് ക്യാൻസൽ!
lines.or: ଟିମ କେ ଏନ ସି, ମିଟିଂ କ୍ୟାନସଲ!

lines.speaker: kojic_acid
lines.en: I'll take the stubborn dark spots.

lines.speaker: alpha_arbutin
lines.en: Uneven tone? Leave it to me.
lines.bn: আনইভেন টোন? আমার ওপর ছেড়ে দাও!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: Three targeted ingredients. One powerful night cream.
lines.bn: তিনটে টার্গেটেড ইনগ্রেডিয়েন্ট। একটা পাওয়ারফুল নাইট ক্রিম।
lines.ta: மூணு டார்கெட்டட் இன்கிரீடியன்ட்ஸ். ஒரே பவர்ஃபுல் நைட் க்ரீம்.
lines.te: మూడు టార్గెటెడ్ ఇంగ్రీడియంట్స్. ఒకే పవర్‌ఫుల్ నైట్ క్రీమ్.
lines.ml: മൂന്ന് ടാർഗെറ്റഡ് ഇൻഗ്രീഡിയന്റ്സ്. ഒരു പവർഫുൾ നൈറ്റ് ക്രീം.
lines.or: ତିନୋଟି ଟାର୍ଗେଟେଡ ଇନଗ୍ରେଡିଏଣ୍ଟ। ଗୋଟିଏ ପାୱାରଫୁଲ ନାଇଟ କ୍ରିମ।

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.en: DERMDOC two percent Kojic Acid Night Cream.
lines.bn: ডার্মডক টু পার্সেন্ট কোজিক অ্যাসিড নাইট ক্রিম।
lines.ta: டெர்ம்டாக் டூ பர்சென்ட் கோஜிக் ஆசிட் நைட் க்ரீம்.
lines.te: డెర్మ్‌డాక్ టూ పర్సెంట్ కోజిక్ యాసిడ్ నైట్ క్రీమ్.
lines.ml: ഡെർമ്ഡോക് ടു പേഴ്സന്റ് കോജിക് ആസിഡ് നൈറ്റ് ക്രീം.
lines.or: ଡର୍ମଡକ ଟୁ ପର୍ସେଣ୍ଟ କୋଜିକ ଏସିଡ ନାଇଟ କ୍ରିମ।

notes: Video is 17.02 s (prompt timeline compressed from 20 s). Whisper returned one segment 5.04-8.16 for two speakers: split at 6.74 ('and') into Kojic Acid (5.04-6.66) and Niacinamide (6.74-8.16) per prompt. Whisper's 'Unventone' = 'Uneven tone' (Alpha Arbutin). The original video likely uses the same generated voice for all characters; distinct pitch offsets (jar +1, Kojic 0, Niacinamide +2, Alpha Arbutin +4) keep the ingredient team audibly distinct. Niacinamide and Alpha Arbutin refs are padded by ~0.05 s of silence to reach 1.5 s. Dark-spot, dullness and uneven-tone villains are on screen but never speak. Narrator lines 'Three targeted ingredients' + 'One powerful night cream' merged into one line.
